# Map

This document will be used to produce maps of Aldabra and the coral sampling sites.

## Load Libraries

```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(osmdata)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggspatial)
```

## Map of Aldabra Atoll with Sampling Sites

```{r}
# Define Aldabra bounding box for OpenStreetMap query
aldabra_bbox <- c(xmin = 46.10, ymin = -9.65, xmax = 46.56, ymax = -9.25)

# Get ultra-detailed coastline data from OpenStreetMap
# This provides Google Maps-like resolution for all coastal features
aldabra_osm <- opq(bbox = aldabra_bbox) |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "natural", value = "coastline") |>
  osmdata_sf()

# Extract coastline geometry
coastline <- aldabra_osm$osm_lines

# Also get water bodies to fill in the atoll's lagoon
aldabra_water <- opq(bbox = aldabra_bbox) |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "natural", value = "water") |>
  osmdata_sf()

water_bodies <- aldabra_water$osm_polygons

# Get island polygons (land)
aldabra_islands <- opq(bbox = aldabra_bbox) |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "place", value = c("island", "islet")) |>
  osmdata_sf()

land_polygons <- NULL
if (!is.null(aldabra_islands$osm_polygons)) land_polygons <- aldabra_islands$osm_polygons
if (!is.null(aldabra_islands$osm_multipolygons)) {
  land_polygons <- if (is.null(land_polygons)) aldabra_islands$osm_multipolygons else dplyr::bind_rows(land_polygons, aldabra_islands$osm_multipolygons)
}

# Load Allen Coral Atlas geomorphic map from local GeoJSON file
geomorphic_map <- st_read("data_analysis/Aldabra-20260127140611/Geomorphic-Map/geomorphic.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(4326)

# Filter to keep only features with "Reef" in the class name
reef_features <- geomorphic_map |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl("Reef", class, ignore.case = TRUE))

# Define sampling sites
sampling_sites <- data.frame(
  site = c("ARM01", "ARM09"),
  latitude = c(-9.40193, -9.413473886),
  longitude = c(46.20131, 46.25736452)
)

# Convert to sf object
sampling_sites_sf <- st_as_sf(sampling_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

# Create the map with OpenStreetMap detail
aldabra_map <- ggplot() +
  # Coral geomorphic map (reef features only)
  {if(!is.null(reef_features) && nrow(reef_features) > 0) geom_sf(data = reef_features, aes(fill = "Coral distribution"), alpha = 0.7, color = NA) else NULL} +
  # Land (islands)
  {if(!is.null(land_polygons) && nrow(land_polygons) > 0) geom_sf(data = land_polygons, fill = "grey", color = NA) else NULL} +
  # Water bodies (lagoons, channels)
  {if(!is.null(water_bodies) && nrow(water_bodies) > 0) geom_sf(data = water_bodies, fill = "#FFFFFF", color = NA) else NULL} +
  
  # Sampling sites
  geom_sf(data = sampling_sites_sf, aes(color = "Sampling site"), size = 4, shape = 16) +
  geom_sf_text(data = sampling_sites_sf, aes(label = site), nudge_x = 0, nudge_y = 0.007, size = 4) +
  
  # Manual scales for legend
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = c("Coral distribution" = "#E8E8E8"), breaks = c("Coral distribution")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("Sampling site" = "skyblue"), breaks = c("Sampling site")) +

  # Map styling
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFFFFF", color = NA),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = c(0.9, 0.115),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(-0.1, "cm")
  ) +

  # Set map extent and show coordinates on all sides
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(46.18, 46.53),
    ylim = c(-9.525, -9.35),
    expand = FALSE,
    crs = st_crs(4326)
  ) +
  
  # Add scale bar
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.3, pad_x = unit(1.6, "cm"), pad_y = unit(0.5, "cm")) +
  
  # Add north arrow
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tr", which_north = "true", 
                         pad_x = unit(0.3, "cm"), pad_y = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                         height = unit(0.8, "cm"), width = unit(0.8, "cm"),
                         style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering)

print(aldabra_map)
  ```

## Save Aldabra Map

```{r}
ggsave("figures/aldabra_map.png", aldabra_map, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)
ggsave("figures/aldabra_map.svg", aldabra_map, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
```
